description_en: Stops a replication pair-consistent group. This operation stops all replication pairs in the replication pair-consistent group
description_zh: 停止一致性复制组中复制对的异步复制功能
kebab_example: aliyun ebs stop-disk-replica-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --replica-group-id pg-myreplica0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StopDiskReplicaGroup

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the replication pair-consistent group
parameters.help_zh: 一致性复制组所属的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the replication pair-consistent group. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426614.html operation to query the IDs of replication pair-consistent groups
parameters.help_zh: 一致性复制组ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426614.html查询一致性复制组ID
parameters.name: replica_group_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token
